The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading companies in the field of metal forming. Automotive More than 100 years of know-how in metal forming technology with finesse in joining and painting, innovative potential in plastics technology and unconventional solutions in torsional vibration technology make up the business unit Automotive of the Winkelmann Group. Building + Industry Our products in the fields of heating, energy and plant engineering are state of the art thanks to our own research, development, cooperation with research institutes and production methods. Steel Services The Steel Services business unit has made a name for itself worldwide as an experienced and competent service provider in steel procurement and guarantees the disposition and just-in-time supply of flat steel products to the processing industry. Winkelmann Group is located in Ahlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, DE.

title: Working For Us | Winkelmann Group
content: # Working at the Winkelmann Group. We are a world-leading group of companies manufacturing industrial solutions of high-performance and energy-efficient components and systems, and many well-known companies from a wide range of industrial sectors are among our customers. It is important to us to be an employer of choice, that supports its employees and offers them future opportunities. Learn more about our corporate culture and discover the many advantages of pursuing a career at the Winkelmann Group. The Winkelmann Group as an employer. Headquartered in Ahlen, in Germany’s Westphalia region, the Winkelmann Group is now in its fourth generation as a family-run business. The approach to work within our group of companies is characterized by collaboration, teamwork, openness and respect as well as quick decision making processes and flat hierarchies. Tradition is just as important to us as innovation: We focus on growth and success every single day and place the highest value on the quality of our processes and products.

title: Metal Forming Specialists - Winkelmann Group
content: Tel: +49 2382 856-0 | info@winkelmann-group.com. # Winkelmann Group. Your partner for industrial solutions of high-performance. Would you like to work in a leading company for industrial solutions of high-performance and energy-efficient components and systems and at the same time take your professional future in your hands? With more than a hundred years of success, our family business, the Winkelmann Group has developed into a leading group of companies worldwide, focusing on our core competence of metal forming. Through our Automotive, reflexGroup, Flowforming and Construction Components business units, we manufacture high-performance systems and components by means of high-tech production processes involving forming, machining and assembly. Ever since the parent company of today’s Winkelmann Group was established in 1898, our head office has been based in Ahlen in Germany’s Westphalia region.
